QF.id: SIA Social Impact Assessment and Assessors_11

question.text: Which of the following is NOT listed in Section 5.3.2 as a core value in the SIA Code of Conduct?

answer.text: Profit maximisation for the SIA's firm

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 5.3.2 lists Non-Judgmental attitude, Integrity, Objectivity, Empathy, Cultural Sensitivity, Transparency, Constructive Feedback, and Professionalism as the core values. 'Profit maximisation for the SIA's firm' is categorically not listed — it is the antithesis of the independence and objectivity requirements. The Trap: All three of A, C, B are expressly listed in Section 5.3.2. D is the outlier. Cross-Exam Context: Professional codes in NISM X-A / X-B, XV, III-A and XXIII all exclude firm-profit maximisation as a governing value; SIA CoC goes further by emphasising empathy and cultural sensitivity. Assessor's Pro-Tip: Before taking on a new empanelment engagement, run a quick self-test against all 8 CoC values; if any value (esp. objectivity or independence) is compromised by scope or fee structure, decline in writing rather than regret later.
